text: Natural Language Processing (NLP) is a part of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. One key area is text understanding, which allows machines to read and make sense of written words. NLP is also used for translation, so people can communicate across different languages more easily. Another useful application is sentiment analysis, where computers identify whether a piece of text is positive, negative, or neutral. This is helpful for understanding customer opinions. Finally, chatbots use NLP to talk with people in a natural way and answer common questions. Thanks to NLP, our daily interaction with technology is becoming simpler and more human-like.
